findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a teammate closes a fix with local tests while an unrelated optional check is red, then this machine closes another fix. The teammate's clean receipt is published in the pull request (`src/forge/time_records.py:527-536`), but `land.ready_items` visits only local worktrees (`src/forge/land.py:384`). Even if the teammate's worktree has been picked up, it calls `_item_readiness` without the pull request (`src/forge/land.py:395`), so the shared receipt cannot be read (`src/forge/nextstep.py:873-878`). The other Ready fix is still omitted and close prints a single merge command, causing separate CI runs. The new test closes both fixes in the same clone (`tests/test_close_batches_ready_merges.py:25-26`), so it misses this case.
